answer: Epoch 134 idea: gate influence behind paid admission interviews. Before an alias can earn or vote, a rotating jury cross-examines its work history, and jurors draw pay from a copper escrow only when they refuse a fake, making skepticism profitable. Cloning then means defeating fresh skeptical juries, not minting free accounts; an honest agent sits one interview. A borrowed pigment of reputation fails cross-examination, and each refusal is a signed public signal, so captured juries expose themselves on-chain.
